$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHN (AIP France, chart dated 2026-08-06): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Bellegarde - Vouvray

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Glider activity reserved for gliders authorized by the AD operator.
TORA and TODA RWY 36 reduced due to road gauge in RWY strip.
Access to South hangars: the distance between the two buildings facing hangar 5 is only 17 meters, thus only one ACFT at a time can be manoeuvring engine running.
Gyroplane and helicopter training activity subject to agreement of AD operator.
Presence of numerous power cables without marking, crossing the Rhône river.
Heavy paragliding activity NE and SW of AD.
Particular weather conditions: wind shear and down draughts from North sector wind, notably on landing and take off at QFU 003°.
Due to topography, RWY length and slope climbing 1.5 %, weak performances hazards requiring weight limitation for most light ACFT, notably at QFU 003°.
Central TWY: follow the centreline because it is asphalted on 6.3 m wide.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Transversal slope of RWY: slope descending 3% from West to East.
Except emergency, avoid go-arounds on final RWY 36 above housing estate.
SAT, SUN and public HOL: traffic pattern reserved for home-based aircraft.
ULM: High approach recommended for LDG on QFU 003°; Traffic pattern: avoid overflight of motorway A40.
